result.quote: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
result.reason: The key is supported, since the prophet buries the man in his own tomb. However, the question is too broad: he also lifts the body, puts it on a donkey, brings it to the city, and lays it in his tomb. Any of these actions could defensibly answer what he does with the body.
